entry.title: JPMorgan Hires Nomura’s International AI Strategy Chief
entry.summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co. is hiring Nomura Holdings Inc.’s international head of artificial intelligence strategy, according to people familiar with the matter, as the Wall Street bank steps up recruitment of AI specialists to boost productivity.

entry.title: I Ran My Business With AI for 30 Days: Results and Lessons

Email responses, client communication, code reviews, architectural decisions, invoicing.
